steps.step_name: Track modifications we're making to our product line

args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine (sales opp→order)
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY (OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesCompensationOrchestrator, etc.) - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY (IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator) - NO REST API for reading safety metrics
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO status + vendor monitoring)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API for machine OEE metrics), BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor (HAZMAT/chemical inventory + regulatory compliance)
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (tracking product modifications/engineering changes), QA agents
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

PRODUCT MODIFICATION TRACKING:
- siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 = PRIMARY for tracking product line modifications
  - Automates engineering change processing & synchronizes configuration updates
  - Capabilities: track-change-status, coordinate-bom-updates, synchronize-engineering-changes, evaluate-change-impact
  - Orchestrates material provisioning & compliance doc updates through product dev cycle

INVENTORY/MATERIAL KEY GAPS:
- NO REST API for reading inventory specifications in landscape
- sap.s4:MaterialReceiptInboundAPI = WRITE-ONLY (inbound goods receipt), NOT read
- Multiple agents exist for BOM/material validation (my.mes, sap.s4, siemens.plm) but these are automation/orchestration, not data retrieval APIs
- Activity "pull current inventory specifications" cannot be fulfilled

args.reason: This PLM agent automates engineering change processing and synchronizes product configuration updates, directly tracking modifications to the product line with change status monitoring and BOM coordination.

LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine (sales opp→order)
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY (OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesCompensationOrchestrator, etc.) - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY (IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator, SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator) - NO REST API for reading safety metrics
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO status + vendor monitoring)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY: IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, AssetProvisioningOrchestrator, ChangeAutomationOrchestrator, IncidentSafetyCoordinator, OccupationalSafetyIncidentCoordinator, VendorContractComplianceOrchestrator, ChangeReleaseCoordinator - NO create API for maintenance submission
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API READ-ONLY for machine metrics), BillOfMaterialsComplianceValidator, HazmatIncidentComplianceMonitor, ProductionChangeOrchestrator, SupplierQualityComplianceOrchestrator - NO maintenance submission API
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, BOMComplianceValidator, EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning (tracking product modifications), QA agents - NO maintenance submission API
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY FINDING - MAINTENANCE SUBMISSION GAP:
- Activity "Enable field technicians to submit equipment maintenance needs through integrated workflow" requires SUBMISSION capability
- NO REST API for CREATING/SUBMITTING maintenance work orders in landscape
- NO agent that ACCEPTS technician maintenance submissions in landscape
- corp.itsm agents process existing tickets (analysis, orchestration) but cannot CREATE them
- my.mes agents orchestrate production changes/quality, not technician maintenance requests
- Activity cannot be fulfilled

PRODUCT MODIFICATION TRACKING:
- siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1 = PRIMARY for product line modifications
  - Capabilities: track-change-status, coordinate-bom-updates, synchronize-engineering-changes, evaluate-change-impact

args.reason: The landscape has no REST API or agent capability to accept/create equipment maintenance submissions from field technicians; existing ITSM and manufacturing resources only process or analyze existing incidents and changes.
